messages:
sanjay: Quick pulse — monthly run on recurring incident 'habitats' (pattern analysis). Can folks drop top causes they've seen in last 90d and propose owners? Need owners + ETA for fixes.
mae: Quick numbers — ran the notebook, top categories (90d): 1) KV cache eviction thrash (12 incidents), 2) model loading OOM (9), 3) autoscale cold starts (7).
leah: Where are the counts from? which tags? need to verify severity-weighting.
mae: Using incidents table (label: recurring=true) + tag=signature. Query snippet:
```
SELECT signature, count(*) as cnt
FROM incidents
WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
AND recurring = TRUE
GROUP BY signature
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
```
omar: KV cache thrash — root cause looks like cache invalidation on shard rebalances; I can own a mitigation (LRU tuning + softer rebalance). Ping me if infra time OK. ETA: 2026-04-15.
tia: Model load OOM — that's hitting older 48GB nodes. We need a quantized-shard fallback and can add pre-warm. I volunteer to own quick patch + runbook update. ETA: 2026-03-30.
leah: Autoscale cold starts — ops-sre should add warm pool and tweak cooldowns. @sanjay can you coordinate with capacity team?
sanjay: Yup will sync with capacity. Proposed actions:
- Owner: omar — KV cache tuning, ETA 2026-04-15
- Owner: tia — quantized fallback + pre-warm, ETA 2026-03-30
- Owner: leah — autoscale warm pool proposal, ETA 2026-04-08
I'll create Jira tickets and link here.
ops-bot: Created ticket RFC-1452 (KV cache tuning) by @omar — https://rwd.inc/jira/RFC-1452
ops-bot: Created ticket BUG-3341 (model pre-warm + quantized fallback) by @tia — https://rwd.inc/jira/BUG-3341
ops-bot: Created ticket OPS-782 (autoscale warm pool) by @leah — https://rwd.inc/jira/OPS-782
mae: Also flagged a recurring pattern for region-us-west that increases latency during canary rollouts. Not sure if it's separate signature or linked to cache thrash.
omar: Good catch — could be correlated. I'll add a correlation test in the RFC dashboard.
tia: Can we add a simple SLO measurement to detect pattern recurrence? Propose: 95p latency for generate endpoint by cluster, alert when 5x baseline.
leah: +1 to SLO guardrail. I'll draft an alert runbook snippet.
sanjay: Meeting: let's do a 30m sync Tue 2026-03-18 10:00 PT to align owners and confirm tickets. If timeline slips, update ticket and ping #incidents.
mae: Added a short dataset for postmortem follow-ups: https://rwd.inc/notebooks/recurring-patterns-2026-03
omar: Will attach perf traces and KV heatmaps to RFC.
tia: I'll update runbook and add rollback play for model fallback.
leah: I'll propose cooldown values in OPS-782 and assign reviewers.
sanjay: Thanks. Action item recaps: omar (RFC-1452) | tia (BUG-3341) | leah (OPS-782) — update by respective ETAs. Re-check in sync on 2026-03-18. :thumbsup:
